parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a kitchen pot, typically made of stainless steel or similar heat-resistant material. It is circular and fits snugly on top of the pot.
parts.Functional_description: The lid helps retain heat and moisture during cooking, allowing food to cook evenly and efficiently. It also prevents splattering.
parts.Movement_description: The lid can be lifted or placed on the pot but does not move independently during use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the kitchen pot, made of stainless steel. It has handles on both sides for lifting and a flat base for stability on stovetops.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds food and liquids for cooking. It distributes heat evenly across its surface for efficient cooking.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary during cooking but can be lifted or moved when handled by the user.
